insertText.text: The programme shall use two types of assessments:

This will be conducted and managed by the college throughout the six terms. It monitors continuous learning through assignments, tests, micro-teaching, practicum and portfolios. Colleges are responsible for administration, marking and recording. Results for this assessment will count towards final certification.

This will be administered by the Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) at the end of the programme. These examinations provide a standardised, national measure of subject knowledge and pedagogical Competence as prescribed by ECZ. ECZ is responsible for setting, moderating and marking these examinations.
